approaches.retained: Tail-sum and dyadic criteria; explicit IID output with an essential infinite-mean coding and radius-zero alternative.
approaches.gap: An upper tail for one representation gives no lower bound for all representations.

approaches.route: Critical colorings and generic coloring lower bounds
approaches.retained: Source-atom exponential lower bound; closure under finite local maps; exact exclusions of mismatched dimensions and moment orders.
approaches.gap: No nonsummable tail lower bound for a critical one-dimensional law.

approaches.route: Hankel rank and hidden Markov representations
approaches.retained: All-orders nonzero determinant formulas exclude finite-state hidden Markov models for the two established critical coloring laws.
approaches.gap: Countable-state representations remain possible; bit-finitary reduction does not cover every continuous-input spatial representation.

approaches.route: Information, covariance, concentration and conditional mixing
approaches.retained: Cut-information bound, tail triviality, additive concentration, and radius-one XOR process with nondecaying conditional boundary influence.
approaches.gap: The easy law invariants already behave well, while unconditional dependence does not provide uniform conditional control.

approaches.retained: Exponential coding by a synchronizing random-map construction, including finitely dependent finite-order Markov laws.
approaches.gap: No finite-state/synchronizing reduction for general finitely dependent laws.
